claims.assertion: Swaruu 9 and Dhor describe post-Tiamat Egypt as an interstellar Federation port where star races guided Lyrian natives; they say the First Directive did not apply.
claims.speaker: Swaruu 9; Dhor Káal’el

claims.assertion: Dhor says Egypt’s interstellar era declined as Reptilian influence grew around Akhenaton and Nefertiti, driving other star races away.
claims.speaker: Dhor Káal’el

claims.assertion: Swaruu 9 says ancient people viewed star visitors as gods because of their technology, and myths exaggerated them; she identifies Horus as a spacecraft.
claims.speaker: Swaruu 9
claims.qualifiers: She links it to Ishtar and Osiris.

coverage_gaps: Pyramid electricity, Egyptian social order, and Tiamat aftermath details omitted
